metadata.description: Connor Ott's Claude Code plugins: plugin-dev, the rules every plugin here is built under; dev-team, which plans a Python project from idea to build; and workflow-analyzer, which draws and replays what a session did.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: The protocol every plugin in this repo is built under: an agreed purpose per plugin, size limits on definitions, contract checks and versioning, enforced by hooks.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Skills that take a project from idea to an enforced build plan: brief, spec, architecture, pipelines, test plan, milestone plan and quality bar, with a shared doc CLI (dt) and hooks.

plugins.name: workflow-analyzer
plugins.description: See, question and replay what any Claude Code session did: draw a chat's turns, agents, tokens, time and files as pages; answer questions about it with step ids; turn it into a replayable eval; compare runs.
